title: delegated-soft-throttle-and-heartbeat-grace-latch
author: Morgan Ellis
release_notes: Introduces a delegated soft-throttle that defers eviction decisions to a regional coordinator and a heartbeat grace latch to prevent double-eviction during transient partitioning. Off by default behind feature flag. Minor telemetry and e2e tests added.
description: Context and motivation: In recent partial-region partition incidents we observed rapid back-to-back eviction decisions leading to tenant hard-failovers and prolonged KV cache loss. This PR introduces two complementary mechanisms: 1) Delegated soft-throttle: a lightweight regional coordinator that receives eviction-suggestion votes from local nodes and issues a short-lived soft throttle decision that is cheaper and less aggressive than full eviction. This prevents simultaneous hard-evict actions while preserving SLOs. 2) Heartbeat grace latch: when nodes detect a transient heartbeat jitter (flapping < 5s), they enter a grace-latch window that suppresses duplicate eviction attempts for that tenant-key-range. Implementation notes: - The feature is guarded by feature flag runtime.delegated_soft_throttle.enabled (default=false) and a runtime.slo_threshold override for canary. - Coordinator is implemented as a probabilistic, gossip-backed leader hint (no single point of failure) and uses existing lease metadata channel; it is intentionally lightweight to avoid adding new long-lived RPC surfaces. - Added metric tags: telemetry.evictions.source (local|delegated), telemetry.evictions.suppressed (true|false), telemetry.heartbeat.flap_count. - Added small e2e scenario in the perf harness that simulates partial regional partition and asserts no tenant experiences >2 consecutive hard evicts within 30s. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of delegated coordinator with fallback to local decision - [x] Heartbeat grace latch algorithm with configurable window - [x] Unit tests for latch edge cases - [x] Integration tests in e2e/regional_failover_test.go - [x] Telemetry and dashboards: updated metrics.yaml and alert hint - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout docs - [x] Smoke tested in canary region (us-west-2a) Summary of commits: - Initial coordinator scaffolding and interface (runtime/eviction/coordinator.go) - Soft-throttle ballot flow and local vote aggregation (runtime/eviction/delegated_throttle.go) - Heartbeat latch algorithm + unit tests (runtime/heartbeat/grace_latch.go, runtime/heartbeat/grace_latch_test.go) - Telemetry + prometheus metrics registration (telemetry/metrics.yaml, telemetry/metrics.go) - E2E test and minor harness changes (e2e/regional_failover_test.go) - Rollout docs and feature flag (docs/ops/feature_flags.md) Notes on backwards compatibility and safety: - Default-off feature flag ensures no impact to users unless enabled. - Coordinator failures fall back to local hard decisions; logic prefers safety over availability when leases are stale (explicitly documented). - Added guards to limit throttle lifetime to 8s to avoid long-term degraded throughput. CI summary: - Initial CI run: unit tests failed due to race in grace_latch_test.go (flaky timer); fixed by switching to a virtual clock in test harness. - Second CI run: all checks passed (unit, integration, linters, go vet). Review discussion highlights: - Riya: "Can we avoid any extra RPC dimension for large clusters?" — Answered: design uses existing lease gossip and an ephemeral ballot carried in existing metadata to avoid new RPCs; added comment in coordinator.go. - Lars: "What happens if the coordinator becomes partitioned alongside a node?" — Clarified: local nodes will time out and run local hard decision; added metrics and an alarm for coordinator ballot saturation. - Chen: requested a shorter default throttle lifetime; lowered from 12s to 8s and added as configurable parameter. Deployment plan: - Gate feature flag behind canary in us-west-2a for 48 hours. - Monitor telemetry.evictions.suppressed and slo.latency.p50/p95 for promoted tenants. - Roll forward to region if no anomalies; otherwise revert flag. Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-20 by Riya Patel with merge commit 4f6d2c8c. Related tickets: Linear ENG-2142 (investigate double-eviction), SRE-93 (production incident RCA).

notes_for_ops: Enable runtime.delegated_soft_throttle.enabled=false by default. For canary set runtime.delegated_soft_throttle.enabled=true and runtime.throttle_lifetime_seconds=8. Watch telemetry.evictions.suppressed and telemetry.evictions.source; alert if suppressed spikes >5x baseline for 10m.
security_considerations: No new auth surfaces introduced; coordinator uses existing lease metadata only. Feature flag defaults to off. Operator docs updated with rollback steps.
testing_instructions: Run unit tests: go test ./runtime/... and e2e: ./scripts/run_e2e -scenario regional-partition. To reproduce locally, enable feature flag in helm values-canary.yaml and run simulator with 3-node region partition.
